description: Find GB goods vehicle and PSV operators by company name, operator licence number (e.g. OB1234567) or Companies House number. Returns up to `limit` matches with status, licence type, traffic area, town and the canonical page URL. Exact licence and company numbers rank first; names match companies and organisations only (sole traders and partnerships are found only by exact licence number and are never named). Optional filters narrow by traffic area, vehicle category, status, licence type or presence in the latest DVSA file.

area.description: Traffic area: slug (e.g. 'scotland', 'north-west-of-england'), letter (B, C, D, F, G, H, K, M) or name

category.description: goods = HGV operators; psv = bus and coach operators

in_current_file.description: true = only licences in the latest DVSA file

query.description: Company name, licence number (two letters + seven digits) or company number

name: search_operators

attribution.description: Attribution text to show with the data

canonical_url.description: The human-readable HaulierScope page for this result

anyOf.description: goods = goods vehicles (HGV); psv = buses and coaches

holder_type.description: company = limited company or LLP; other = public body, charity or similar; sole_trader_or_partnership = an individual (name never published here)

licence_number.description: Licence matched, or the operator's largest licence for name matches

match.description: How the hit matched: exact licence number, exact company number, or company name

name.description: Operator name; null for sole traders and partnerships and withheld names

anyOf.description: Licence status in the DVSA file. 'unmapped' = a status code we have not mapped yet; never treat it as valid.

status.description: no_match never means 'no licence' or 'unlicensed': the name may be spelt differently. unsupported_coverage = not a GB licence (e.g. Northern Ireland).

file_date.description: Date of the DVSA operator licence file the data describes (null before the first import)

markdown_url.description: Markdown version of the canonical page

retrieved_at.description: When this response was generated (ISO timestamp)

source.description: Data source(s) the result is built from

source_url.description: Where the primary source dataset is published

title: Search operator licences
